content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"eq","value":11},{"path":"body.y","op":"eq","value":1}]},"modes":[{"id":"fight","priority":30,"when":{"all":[{"path":"nearest(monster).dist","op":"lte","value":1}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"fight-back"}},{"id":"navigate","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"path":"body.x","op":"gte","value":0}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"go-ladder"}}],"skills":[{"name":"fight-back","skill":"async (b) => { const ms = await b.monsters(); if (!ms.length) return {ok:true}; const p = await b.body(); let best = null, bd = 1e9; for (const m of ms) { const d = Math.abs(m.x-p.x)+Math.abs(m.y-p.y); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = m; } } if (!best) return {ok:true}; if (bd > 1) { const r = await b.walkTo(best.x, best.y, 'adjacent'); b.log('approach: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); return r; } const r = await b.faceAndPress(best.x, best.y, 'ControllerX', 0); b.log('fight: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); return r; }","check":"async (b) => { const ms = await b.monsters(); return {ok: ms.length === 0, detail: 'monsters left: ' + ms.length}; }"},{"name":"go-ladder","skill":"async (b) => { const r = await b.walkTo(11, 1, 'stand'); b.log('walkTo ladder: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); return r; }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); return {ok: p.x === 11 && p.y === 1, detail: 'at ' + p.x + ',' + p.y}; }"}]}
